_meta.purpose: Stand-in funnel/close/value numbers for the HMP App and hh.py weekly, until real HMP numbers replace them once FilthE has knocked and closed jobs.
_meta.confidence: search-summary industry figures (vendor blogs, roofing sales-training sites), not opened primary sources or audited studies. Ranges shown low/typical/high; use typical as the default, low/high for sensitivity. Replace with HMP's own data as soon as there is enough of it (recommend after ~200 real doors knocked).
_meta.note: Every figure here is a vendor claim unless marked otherwise. No Nebraska- or Fremont-specific figures were found; national/Midwest general figures only.

doors_to_conversation.unit: % of doors knocked that result in any conversation (answer)
doors_to_conversation.source: vendor blogs (spotio.com, theroofstrategist.com) - typical door-to-door answer rate
doors_to_conversation.verified: 2026-09-27 (round 43): direct fetch of spotio.com/blog/door-to-door-sales/ confirms 'the target is typically a 30-40% contact rate on a given pass through a neighborhood' - typical/high match exactly; SPOTIO's own stated floor is 30%, a bit above this file's low of 20% (20% likely covers weaker/rookie performers this specific quote doesn't address) - kept low as-is, not changed.

doors_per_hour.unit: doors knocked per hour in normal neighborhoods (25-35 on a tight route)
doors_per_hour.source: docs/research/2026-09-26-round-6.md rookie benchmarks (industry-typical, unverified); typical = midpoint

doors_to_qualified_inspection_new_rep.unit: % of doors knocked -> booked inspection, first 30 days
doors_to_qualified_inspection_new_rep.source: ilroofinginstitute.com - new door knocker in first 30 days

doors_to_qualified_inspection_experience.unit: % of doors knocked -> booked inspection, experienced rep/company

doors_to_appointment_company_median.unit: % doors -> appointment, median company (broader funnel measure, may include other lead sources)
doors_to_appointment_company_median.source: subcontractorhub.com close-rate benchmarks - median vs top-quartile

appointment_to_inspection.unit: % of booked appointments that actually happen (homeowner shows up / lets inspector on roof)

inspection_to_signed_contract.unit: % of inspections that convert to a signed contract

overall_close_rate_exclusive_leads.unit: % of exclusive/own-generated leads (like door knocks) that close
overall_close_rate_exclusive_leads.verified: 2026-09-27 (round 43): corroborated (not identical metric) by a direct fetch of spotio.com/blog/door-to-door-sales/, which independently states 'well-run teams close 30-40% of qualified inspection leads' - same order of magnitude from a second, directly-opened source. subcontractorhub.com itself was not reachable this round to confirm word-for-word.

overall_close_rate_shared_leads.unit: % close rate for shared/bought leads (NOT what HMP uses - no bought lists - kept for contrast only)

follow_up_touches_to_close.unit: number of contacts (calls/texts/visits) needed before a lead converts
follow_up_touches_to_close.source: ghostrep.ai, leadresponse.co - roofing-lead follow-up cadence studies

days_lead_response_speed_advantage.unit: qualitative: first contractor to respond to a fresh lead wins the job
days_lead_response_speed_advantage.typical: 81% win rate when first to respond; 5 min response = 100x more likely to convert vs 30 min

avg_hail_wind_insurance_payout.unit: USD, average insurance payout for a wind/hail roof claim
avg_hail_wind_insurance_payout.source: insuranceclaimrecoverysupport.com, nwclaimsmanagement.com - national average payout figures

claim_underpayment_recovered_with_docume.unit: USD typically identified/recovered via supplements when properly documented (photos, inspection report, detailed estimate)

estimate_vs_actual_scope_gap.unit: USD gap between insurer's first estimate and true repair cost, per claim

mortgage_check_endorsement_delay.unit: weeks added to payment timeline when a mortgage company must endorse the insurance check
mortgage_check_endorsement_delay.source: roofing-claim-process guides (weathershieldroofers.com, kreunen/insuranceroofs.com summary) - start the endorsement request the day the check arrives, do not wait for the contractor

supplement_filing_window.unit: days after initial payment that most policies allow a supplement to be filed

overhead_and_profit_pct.unit: % added to an insurance estimate when 3+ trades are coordinated by a general contractor (the '3-trade rule')
overhead_and_profit_pct.source: capout.ai / estimateondemand.com Xactimate glossary - 10% overhead + 10% profit, industry-standard, often disputed/stripped by carriers

avg_siding_replacement_job_cost.unit: USD, full house siding replacement (materials + labor), cash sale not insurance
avg_siding_replacement_job_cost.source: angi.com / homeadvisor 2026 cost guides - national averages, not Nebraska-specific

referral_program_gift_response.unit: % of customers more likely to refer after receiving a thank-you gift (not cash-for-claim, not a deductible discount)
referral_program_gift_response.source: hookagency.com / referral-marketing vendor blog - vendor claim, no methodology shown

seasonal_note.value: Fall named repeatedly as a strong season to ask for referrals (post-storm-season word of mouth); winter (Nov-Mar) is HMP's own slow window per CLAUDE.md's todaywalk seasonal rule - no seasonal split found for close rates specifically.
seasonal_note.source: jobnimbus.com 'why fall is the best time to ask' (title/summary only, page not opened)
